_comment: This computer's violations settings. Change them in Violations Settings (desktop icon) rather than by hand. Created from violations_config.example.json by install.ps1; never committed to GitHub.
_mode_help: test = violations go onto the TEST prospect (Clippy Testapplicant DELETE ME), nothing prints, reminders are marked [TEST]. live = the real tenant's History & Notes, real printing, real reminders.

items.label: Too many vehicles (2 per home maximum)
Posting of signs is not allowed
Pet chained outside without owner at home

_items_help: Same checklist as the paper Violation Notice. days + rule: 'exact' = that many days later; 'next_monday' = that many days later, then on to the next Monday (4 days + next Monday always gives a full weekend and a Monday deadline, 4-10 days out). THESE ARE STARTING GUESSES - set the real ones on the Violations screen.
_users_help: The manager who signs in on the phone. Name is printed on notices ('By ...'). The password is set in Violations Settings and stored only as a salted hash.
_printer_help: Windows printer name, or null to save the PDF without printing. print_photos adds the photo pages to the printout (they're always on the PDF saved to Rent Manager).

reminders._help: Manager computers: leave email off — overdue violations show at the top of the phone app. (Codi's own computer turns email + Moornings on.)

_short_help: short = the tile text on the phone; label = the full wording printed on the notice.
_parks_help: Which parks this computer handles (ticked in Violations Settings). A manager with two parks gets a park choice on the lot screen.
